description: DB integration: resolveEffectiveBillingIdentity returns client preferred method when profile NULL, profile value when set (overriddenFields includes preferred_payment_method), and null when client value is '' — against migrated schema
DB integration: update settings action persists a valid method, clears to NULL on null, and returns action error for 'bitcoin'; direct insert of invalid value is rejected by CHECK constraint
DB integration: saved-card read returns only the target profile's default non-deleted card and nothing for a sibling profile; returns none when no card

DB integration: generating invoices for a client with two separately-billed profiles (one override=check, one inheriting credit_card) stores the respective payment_method on each invoice; later profile edit does not change the issued invoice
Unit: invoice adapter maps payment_method keys to labels and null to null; field catalog exposes invoice.paymentMethod and preview renders it
Component: profile settings panel shows inherit option labelled with client's value, saves selected key / null, and renders card-on-file vs 'No card on file'
